records.title: Payment deduplication
records.rationale: An idempotency key identifies one operation across repeated requests. The gateway must return the earlier outcome without performing the charge again.
records.query: Why should resending checkout not charge a customer twice?

records.title: Bounded retries
records.rationale: retry_budget caps attempts at three. Exponential backoff and an overall deadline prevent a temporary network fault from creating unbounded repeated calls.
records.query: How do we keep a flaky network from causing endless repeated calls?

records.title: Tenant rate quotas
records.rationale: Apply independent traffic limits per organization. One tenant exhausting its allowance must not consume every other tenant's request capacity.
records.query: How do we keep one customer's traffic from slowing everyone else down?

records.title: Catalog cache invalidation
records.rationale: A price update evicts the saved catalog entry. Waiting only for expiration would serve a stale amount after the database value changes.
records.query: Why must refreshing a price remove previously saved product data?

records.title: Transactional outbox
records.rationale: Save the domain update and pending event in one database transaction. A separate publisher delivers the event after commit so a failed save cannot announce work that never happened.
records.query: How do we ensure a message is sent only after the database save succeeds?

records.title: Expand contract migration
records.rationale: Keep the old column while new application replicas learn the replacement field. Remove it only after every active release stops reading it.
records.query: Why can we not delete the old field immediately during a rollout?

records.title: Cancel obsolete UI requests
records.rationale: Abort an earlier fetch when the user selects another product. Also verify the response belongs to the current selection before replacing visible content.
records.query: How can an older network response be prevented from overwriting a newly selected project?

records.title: Service membership isolation
records.intent: Restrict shared records to permitted components
records.rationale: A reader must belong to every service touched by a record. Apply organization, product and service conditions inside database queries before returning results.
records.query: Why should a teammate see only the components they belong to?

records.title: Optimistic revision checks
records.rationale: An edit must provide the revision it started from. Reject an outdated revision so a second writer cannot silently replace the first writer's changes.
records.query: How do we stop two people from silently losing each other's changes?

records.title: Stable cursor pagination
records.rationale: Use a stable ordering and an explicit cursor rather than a shifting offset. Validate the cursor within the same scope and filters to avoid repeating or skipping records.
records.query: How do we avoid duplicate records while scrolling a changing list?

records.title: Edit acknowledgement snapshots
records.intent: Bind human review to actual file state
records.rationale: A reviewed edit acknowledgement is usable only for its exact operation, targets and file snapshot. Changed content needs a new review instead of reusing an old acknowledgement.
records.query: Why must permission for an edit depend on the contents of the file?

records.title: Private capture retention
records.intent: Keep raw discussions local and short lived
records.rationale: Retain captured conversation payloads only within the local encrypted journal deadline. Publish reviewed knowledge summaries through a separate path, never the original transcript.
records.query: Why do we delete local conversation messages without uploading them to teammates?

records.title: Cart quantity refresh
records.rationale: Customers may intentionally add the same item more than once. Preserve the requested quantity in the cart view.

records.title: Image dimensions
records.rationale: Reserve aspect ratios before loading pictures to avoid layout shifts in the product gallery.

records.title: Calendar announcements
records.rationale: Send an invitation for a planned meeting and include its start time and room.

records.title: Release history
records.rationale: A changelog describes the improvements shipped in each release for later reference.
